nodes.name: 1. Webhook — Receive Batch from Web Console
nodes.notes: Web Console calls this after user confirms product + image selections.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'received', count: ($json.body && $json.body.items ? $json.body.items.length : ($json.items ? $json.items.length : 0)), message: 'Batch accepted by n8n. Starting Flux Dev AI pipeline...' }) }}

nodes.name: 2. Split Items — Process One Product at a Time
3. Classifier — Is Image a White Cutout?
nodes.notes: Evaluates if selected listing photo is a white cutout background or existing room lifestyle photo.

string.name: ai_prompt
string.value: ={{ 'The input photo is an isolated product cutout on a plain white studio background featuring \'' + ($json.title || 'Cozy Decor') + '\'. Synthesize a brand-new, complete 8K photorealistic 3:4 lifestyle room background from scratch: place the product naturally onto a cozy aesthetic bedside table or oak desk setup. Integrate the isolated product seamlessly into this new room setting with realistic contact drop shadows and natural ambient light bleeding. Preserve main physical product shape and textures 100% accurately while rendering a high-end Architectural Digest room scene around it. Leave generous clean negative space at the top for headline text.' }}

nodes.name: 4a. Set Prompt A (White Cutout Room Placement)
nodes.notes: Applied for studio cutout photos: Synthesizes a new cozy room scene with drop shadows.

string.name: ai_prompt
string.value: ={{ 'Transform the uploaded product image into a premium luxury commercial advertisement while preserving the original product. Product details: ' + ($json.title || 'Cozy Decor') + ' featuring realistic materials, authentic textures, and clean physical geometry. The uploaded product is the main subject and must remain visually consistent with reference image. Enhance surrounding room background with warm cinematic lighting, soft shadows, realistic reflections, and 8K golden hour ambient light. Leave generous clean negative space for headline text.' }}

nodes.name: 4b. Set Prompt B (Existing Room Relighting)
nodes.notes: Applied for existing room photos: Relights and enhances existing room scene with 8K cinematic ambient light.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ input: { prompt: $json.ai_prompt, image: ($node['Code in JavaScript'].json.chosen_photo_url || ''), prompt_strength: parseFloat($json.prompt_strength || 0.5), aspect_ratio: '3:4', output_format: 'jpg', output_quality: 100 } }) }}

nodes.name: 5. Replicate API — Flux Dev AI Generation
nodes.notes: Generates 8K commercial visual using Flux Dev AI via Replicate API.

nodes.name: 6. Build Bridge Page + Playwright Price Overlay
nodes.notes: Renders Playwright luxury price badge overlay on top of generated AI image, generates bridge_{ASIN}.html landing page, and pushes live to GitHub Pages.

nodes.name: 7. Post Pin to Pinterest API v5
nodes.notes: POSTs the Pin with generated Flux Dev AI visual and SEO text to Pinterest API v5.

string.name: result
string.value: ={{ 'Pin posted for ' + ($node['Code in JavaScript'].json.asin || 'N/A') + ' — Pin ID: ' + ($json.id || 'N/A') + ' | Bridge: ' + ($node['6. Build Bridge Page + Playwright Price Overlay'].json.bridge_url || '') }}
